name: rollups
description: The volume rollups the widgets read -- six families (interface pair and peer, owner, client, peer address, site name, rule), four periods each -- the purged part of each hour, and the daily per-address-pair volumes. The tables are this plugin's (ADR 0020 wave 5); the refresh that computes them is still the collector's, reaching them through the bridge until the widgets move, as ADR 0020's progress records.

checks.name: scope_of_direction
checks.expression: traffic_scope = CASE WHEN traffic_direction IN ('to_this_firewall', 'from_this_firewall') THEN 'this_firewall' WHEN src_interface_id IS NOT NULL AND dst_interface_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'east_west' ELSE 'north_south' END

checks.name: inter_interface_has_both_ends
checks.expression: traffic_direction IN ('to_this_firewall', 'from_this_firewall') OR ((traffic_direction = 'inter_interface') = (src_interface_id IS NOT NULL AND dst_interface_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: outbound_leaves_an_interface
checks.expression: traffic_direction IN ('to_this_firewall', 'from_this_firewall') OR src_interface_id IS NULL OR dst_interface_id IS NOT NULL OR traffic_direction = 'outbound'

checks.name: inbound_reaches_an_interface
checks.expression: traffic_direction IN ('to_this_firewall', 'from_this_firewall') OR src_interface_id IS NOT NULL OR dst_interface_id IS NULL OR traffic_direction = 'inbound'
